title: kate-core: skip a bad editorconfig file
summary: read_editorconfig skips a path that is not a file. It also skips a file larger than one mebibyte. A skipped file does not set root. This packet does not change reload. It does not add a dependency. Linux CI runs the tests.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust. It does not need a window or a review by the owner. Linux CI runs the tests. Also run cargo check for aarch64-apple-darwin.

definitions.definition:
pub const MAX_EDITORCONFIG_BYTES: u64 = 1_048_576;

pub fn read_editorconfig(start: &std::path::Path) -> ModeOverride

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Before read_to_string, require is_file. If the length is greater than MAX_EDITORCONFIG_BYTES, do not read the bytes. A directory named .editorconfig is skipped. An oversized file is skipped. Neither one stops the parent walk as root. The oversized-file test is the regression. The directory test already passes on main. Keep that test. Do not edit workspace.rs. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: modeline::tests::an_oversized_editorconfig_is_skipped
regression_tests.asserts: This is the regression test. It fails on main. A file one byte over MAX_EDITORCONFIG_BYTES is not applied. Its root = true does not stop the walk.

regression_tests.name: modeline::tests::a_directory_named_editorconfig_is_skipped
regression_tests.asserts: This check already passes on main. Keep it. A directory named .editorconfig does not change the override. The walk still reads a higher file when root is not set.
